__commentExample.__comment_name: unique profile name referenced by ConfigIdentities.json voiceProfile
__commentExample.__comment_provider: optional provider override. Supported values are qwen3-local, chatterbox-local, windows-local, elevenlabs, or empty to use the global Generated speech TTS provider setting
__commentExample.__comment_elevenLabsVoiceId: optional ElevenLabs voice id override for this profile
__commentExample.__comment_windowsLocalVoice: optional Windows SAPI voice name override for this profile
__commentExample.__comment_qwen3Voice: optional OpenAI-compatible voice or server-side profile identifier sent to the local qwen3 TTS server. This can point at a clone profile in Tools/Qwen3LocalTtsServer/voice_profiles.json
__commentExample.__comment_qwen3Model: optional local qwen3 TTS model id override
__commentExample.__comment_qwen3Endpoint: optional local qwen3 TTS endpoint override. You can use a full /v1/audio/speech endpoint or a base /v1 endpoint
__commentExample.__comment_qwen3ResponseFormat: optional response format such as wav, mp3, or ogg
__commentExample.__comment_qwen3Speed: optional qwen3-local playback speed multiplier. Values greater than 0 override the global setting
__commentExample.__comment_chatterboxVoice: optional server-side Chatterbox voice profile identifier sent to the local helper. Prefer named profiles in Tools/Qwen3LocalTtsServer/voice_profiles.json because Chatterbox voices are usually driven by reference audio rather than raw speaker ids
__commentExample.__comment_chatterboxModel: optional Chatterbox model selector override. Prefer chatterbox for best quality; use chatterbox-turbo only when latency matters. Supported built-in values are chatterbox, chatterbox-turbo, chatterbox-multilingual, or a local checkpoint path handled by the helper
__commentExample.__comment_chatterboxEndpoint: optional local Chatterbox helper endpoint override. You can use a full /v1/audio/speech endpoint or a base /v1 endpoint
__commentExample.__comment_chatterboxResponseFormat: optional response format such as wav or pcm16
__commentExample.__comment_chatterboxSpeed: optional chatterbox-local playback speed multiplier. Values greater than 0 override the global setting
__commentExample.__comment_chatterboxExaggeration: optional chatterbox-local style exaggeration override. Use a negative value to defer to the helper profile/model default. Higher values can sound phasey or overly roomy on clone voices
__commentExample.__comment_chatterboxLanguage: optional language hint for chatterbox-local. Set to auto to use the accepted faster-whisper language for each utterance
